creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A list item was written back without the quoting needed to recover it. Items
holding a newline came back as two. Items opening with the body-escape prefix
came back shorter. Items shaped like a section header spliced a section into the
case and left a file that no longer parsed.

Root cause was two decoders against one encoder: listOf ran both unescapeLine
and unquoteListItem, while quoteListItem only guarded the second. A list now
carries exactly one convention.
title: Corrupting list writes: quote what the reader will decode
